name: an AsyncQueue alone
code: import { AsyncQueue } from '@reely/queue'; void new AsyncQueue().add(() => 1);

name: both queues and a store
code: import { AsyncQueue, SyncQueue } from '@reely/queue'; import { PrimitiveStore } from '@reely/simple-store'; new SyncQueue().add(() => 1); void new AsyncQueue().add(() => 1); new PrimitiveStore(0).value = 1;
